title: Service NSW Business Profile – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This notice explains what personal information Service NSW collects when you manage a Business Profile, how it is used, and your rights regarding that information.
who_can_apply: Individuals or businesses that need to manage licenses, registrations, or perform transactions through a Service NSW Business Profile.
what_you_need: Australian Business Number (ABN), Australian Company Number (ACN), or other business identifier
Contact details (email address and phone number)

faqs.q: What is the purpose of collecting my business information?
faqs.a: Information is collected to manage licenses and registrations, help you apply for grants or rebates, perform online transactions, and provide details about available services.

faqs.q: What information is collected for a Business Profile?
faqs.a: Details collected include your ABN or ACN, entity name, business name, personal name, contact details, business and mailing addresses, role within the business, and date of birth.
Your information helps pre-complete online forms, enables transactions with NSW Government agencies, assists customer service, and allows you to share details with other agencies with your consent.
